questions.stem: Which declaration creates an integer array of five elements?
questions.solution: int a[5]; reserves five integer elements.

questions.stem: Which data type stores a whole number?
questions.solution: int stores whole numbers; float stores real values.

questions.stem: Which operator reads data from cin?
questions.solution: The extraction operator >> reads from an input stream.

questions.stem: Which part of a for loop is executed after each iteration?
questions.solution: The update expression runs after each iteration.

questions.stem: Which declaration creates a floating-point variable named price?
questions.solution: float is used for real numbers.

options: Translates the whole source program before execution
Executes one source statement at a time
questions.solution: A compiler translates the complete source file into object code.

questions.stem: Which values can a bool variable hold?
questions.solution: A bool holds true or false.

questions.stem: Which phase of the program development life cycle defines what the program must do?
questions.solution: Analysis establishes the requirements before design and coding.

questions.stem: Which structure chooses between two alternative paths?
How many times does a while loop execute when its condition is false initially?
questions.solution: while is a pretest loop; a false condition skips the body.

questions.stem: This question tests high-level languages and debugging.

parts.text: Define syntax error and logic error.
parts.answer: A syntax error violates the language grammar and is detected by the compiler. A logic error produces incorrect output although the program runs.
parts.label: a

parts.text: Explain TWO advantages of high-level languages over machine language.
parts.answer: They are easier to read and write, portable across machines, and supported by compilers and debugging tools.
parts.solution: Award 1.5 marks for each valid advantage.
parts.label: b

questions.stem: A program reads a positive integer N and calculates the sum and average of the numbers 1 to N.

parts.text: Draw a flowchart for the sum and average calculation.
parts.answer: Start -> read N -> total = 0, count = 1 -> while count <= N add count -> average = total / N -> display total and average -> end.
parts.solution: Award marks for input, initialisation, loop condition, accumulator, average and output.
parts.label: a

parts.text: Write pseudocode and a complete C++ program for the algorithm.
parts.answer: Use a for loop from 1 to N, accumulate total, compute average as double(total)/N, then display both values.
parts.solution: Award marks for loop, accumulator, correct average type and output.
parts.label: b

questions.stem: This question tests type conversion and constants.

parts.text: Explain the difference between implicit and explicit type conversion, and give one C++ example of each.
parts.answer: Implicit conversion is automatic (int to double); explicit conversion uses a cast such as double(total) or static_cast<double>(total).
parts.solution: Award marks for both definitions and valid examples.
parts.label: a

parts.text: Write a C++ program segment that calculates the average of three integer marks as a double and displays it to two decimal places.
parts.answer: double average = (m1 + m2 + m3) / 3.0; cout << fixed << setprecision(2) << average;
parts.solution: Award marks for floating-point division, fixed/setprecision and output.
parts.label: b

parts.text: Trace the program and state the output.
parts.solution: The loop adds 1+2+3+4+5. Award marks for the sequence and final output.
parts.label: a

parts.text: Rewrite the loop using a while loop. Then explain what changes if the condition is i < 5.
parts.answer: int i = 1; while (i <= 5) { total += i; i++; } With i < 5 the result is 10 because 5 is not added.
parts.solution: Award marks for correct while structure, update and changed result.
parts.label: b

questions.stem: A sports club stores sport names and medal counts in parallel arrays.

parts.text: Declare two parallel arrays for five sports and initialise them with suitable values.
parts.solution: Award marks for both declarations, correct sizes and related indices.
parts.label: a

parts.text: Write a program segment to display each sport with its medals, then calculate the total and average medals.
parts.answer: Loop i=0..4 to display sports[i] and medals[i], accumulate total, average = double(total)/5.
parts.solution: Award marks for paired display, total, average and output.
parts.label: b

questions.stem: A bookstore records up to five books. Each book has a title, price and quantity in stock.
questions.solution: Award 3 marks for struct definition, 4 for input, 4 for inventory value, 3 for most expensive and 1 for output.
